source_caption_text:
Cardi B’s mom kept her old room exactly the same in case she ever goes broke and has to move back home 😭😂

Cardi went from building a following on social media and appearing on “Love & Hip Hop: New York” to becoming one of rap’s biggest names. “Bodak Yellow” reached No. 1 in 2017, and her debut album “Invasion of Privacy” made her the first solo female rapper to win Best Rap Album at the Grammys in 2019. 🏆 

Beyond music, she’s expanded into movies, brand partnerships and business ventures. Celebrity Net Worth estimates her fortune at around $120 million, although that’s an unofficial estimate rather than a confirmed figure from Cardi. 

But no matter how successful she gets, her mom is keeping that backup plan ready 😂❤️
